# {{page-title}}

This page provides a list of the FHIR artifacts defined as part of this implementation guide.

## Profiles

<table class="grid" style="width:100%">
<tbody>
  <tr>
     <td>{{pagelink:StructureDefinition-bh-grant-info, text:Behavioral Health Grant Funding Information}}</td>
     <td>This profile defines the structure and terminology for Observations related to Program ID, number, and funding type. Feedback is requested throughout this profile, specifically do standard concepts exist for .category, .code, and .value[x]? Also, use of a complex extension to represent both grant number and program ID.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
     <td>{{pagelink:StructureDefinition-program-info, text:Grant Program ID and Number}}</td>
     <td>This complex extension defines the representation of Grant Program ID as well as grant number.</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
     <td>{{pagelink:StructureDefinition-mental-health-clinical-notes, text:Mental Health Clinical Notes}}</td>
     <td>This profile on US Core DocumentReference constrains type to be of five allowable mental health clinical note types via binding to Mental Health Clinical Notes (ValueSet)</td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>
